title: Arlington, TX — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

Overview

Arlington is a city in TX with a population of 400,000. Entertainment hub with AT&T Stadium, Six Flags, and the University of Texas at Arlington. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.6.
